svg.title: In the frame realization the replica background is the readout of a raw coarse pair, replica V = πf(replicaZ(s, B)), and Me is conjugated by the fine frame at the initial vertex of e: Me 7→r−1 x Merx, ue 7→r−1 x uerx. Since log(exp(Ada) AdM) = Ad log(exp a M) and χd depends on the invariant norm, ΦM is equivariant, ΦAdM ◦Ad = Ad ◦ΦM, and jM is invariant. The horizontal lift, its determinant and LV are therefore fibre constants, recovered exactly on the identity-frame section.
